topics.label: SNIPE
topics.title: Snipe: Keys to a Happy Long-Term Relationship for Business Owners
topics.perspective: A business owner building on Isabel's list from his own marriage, adding to it rather than reacting to it. Warm and plain, never preachy, and nothing his wife wouldn't be glad to read.
topics.objective: Saves + Reach. The inspo got 1K bookmarks and 136 reposts on 1.4K likes (69.2K views) but only 9 comments, so it spreads through saves and shares.

topics.label: SNIPE
topics.title: Snipe: Correct It the First Time
topics.perspective: A founder who develops people, speaking from the team he's built. Correcting early should read as coaching, never as discipline or calling anyone out.
topics.objective: Reach + Comments. The inspo got 784 reposts and 65 comments on 4.1K likes (58.2K views), so it spreads through reposts.

topics.title: Meet [Team Member]
topics.perspective: A founder giving one teammate their credit through a specific backstory and a specific win. Warm and plain, never gushing.
topics.objective: Reach + Comments. That second hit shows team spotlights are repeatable, so this puts the lane into the regular rotation.

topics.title: Infographics in Email Copy: Josh's Take
topics.vehicle: Medium Form + client email examples image (X/LI)
topics.perspective: An operator giving his own view from the accounts he runs. Max runs a competing ecom email and SMS business, so even a disagreement should read as a different view, never a jab.
topics.objective: Saves + Comments. Real client emails with click-rate numbers turn this into proof, and taking a side on someone else's claim invites replies.

topics.title: I'm Josh: The Chronos Story
topics.perspective: A founder telling his own story in the past tense and letting the numbers carry it. Relaxed and plain, never a flex.
topics.objective: Saves + Reach. It expands "Me 8 years ago" (56/6), the top X post of the last 30 days, into the full story.

topics.title: Escaping Poverty (Repurpose)
topics.perspective: A founder explaining where his drive came from, plainly. No self-pity and no rags-to-riches flex.
topics.objective: Comments + Reach. So this reruns the story in the voice that's working now.

topics.title: Every Retention Flow Tip (Repurpose)
topics.perspective: An operator handing over his full flow checklist from 8 years of accounts. It talks straight to "you," as published.
topics.objective: Saves + Comments. Splitting the 22 tips into slides and tweets makes the list easy to save.
